beats.quote: Every night the TV goes back on. Every night we fight.

beats.line: Bedtime. The TV goes back on. Again.

beats.me: She keeps putting the TV back on at bedtime. Every night ends in a fight. What do I do?

digi: Tonight: tell her once. Ten minutes on the timer, then the TV goes off.
Then: a calm switch off earns ten minutes together, and she chooses what.
Every night: the same ending, no extra minutes. One extension resets it.

beats.line: Ten minutes on the timer. Said once.
TV off. Ten minutes together, her choice.
Her deal, in her own app.
She picks the screen. Her timer ends it.
Five nights on, DiGi checks back.
The timer goes. She switches it off herself.
Her phone sleeps in the kitchen. Her choice.
